question: Which epithets attribute destructive power, earthly sovereignty, and slender beauty to the goddess?
premises: The goddess is named kṣayaṅkarī, the one who causes decay.
The goddess is named kṣitīśā, the lady who rules the earth.
The goddess is named kṣīṇamadhyasuśobhanā, very beautiful with a slender waist.
inference: These epithets together ascribe transformative power, sovereign authority, and exquisite form to the goddess.
plain_english: She is the causer of decay, the lady of the earth, and beautifully slender-waisted.
